note: MUFG Bank's explanation of its ordinary deposit account (as of 1 May 2023, the edition it publishes): its fee section names no fee for keeping the account, only card fees, an unused-account fee (an account opened from July 2021 with no deposit or withdrawal for two years is charged 1,320 yen a year as unused) and a paper-passbook fee (for accounts from April 2022, 550 yen a year), neither of which the game's account incurs. Read 2026-10-30 from MUFG's fee lists: a transfer through MUFG Direct to another bank is 154 yen under 30,000 yen and 220 yen from 30,000 (to MUFG nothing; person-to-person up to 100,000 yen free through Bank Pay); the domestic figure written is the lower tier. A transfer abroad online to another bank is 3,000 yen plus, sent in yen, 0.05% of the amount at least 2,500 yen, written as 3,000 yen plus 0.05% at least 5,500 yen in all (the same sum at every amount; one to MUFG's own branch abroad is 2,500). Withdrawals with the MUFG card at MUFG, partner and convenience-store machines are free from 8:45 to 21:00 and 110 yen at other hours (written as free). Not stated: the ordinary deposit's rate (applied as displayed in branches daily, not published in these documents), overdraft (the ordinary account alone has none; the general account's secured overdraft is a separate product), a returned payment, a card share abroad, what opening asks.
